title: Eliminate SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 code uses string concatenation for SQL queries, creating critical security vulnerabilities that allow database manipulation attacks
risk_if_unaddressed: Data breach, unauthorized access to customer accounts, regulatory violations, potential financial losses
suggested_approach: Implement parameterized queries using Entity Framework or similar ORM, add input validation layer, implement prepared statements for all database operations
success_criteria: All SQL queries use parameterized inputs
Static analysis shows no string concatenation in SQL
Penetration testing confirms no SQL injection vulnerabilities
Code review approval from security team

title: Implement Comprehensive Input Validation
problem_statement: No input validation exists for account numbers, amounts, or other user inputs in banking operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Invalid data processing, potential system crashes, business logic bypass, data corruption
suggested_approach: Implement validation attributes in C# models, add server-side validation middleware, create validation rules for account numbers and monetary amounts
success_criteria: All inputs validated before processing
Proper error messages for invalid inputs
Unit tests cover all validation scenarios
No unvalidated data reaches database layer

provenance.evidence: Direct use of txtAccountNo.Text without validation
Direct use of txtAmount.Text without validation

title: Implement Transaction Auditing and Logging
problem_statement: No audit trail or logging exists for banking transactions, violating compliance requirements and preventing fraud detection
risk_if_unaddressed: Regulatory compliance violations, inability to detect fraud, no transaction history for disputes
suggested_approach: Implement structured logging with transaction IDs, create audit tables for all financial operations, add correlation IDs for request tracking
success_criteria: All transactions logged with timestamps and user context
Audit logs are tamper-evident and immutable
Compliance team approves audit trail completeness
Log retention meets regulatory requirements

title: Implement Robust Error Handling
problem_statement: No error handling exists for database operations, potentially causing application crashes and poor user experience
risk_if_unaddressed: Application instability, poor user experience, potential data inconsistency, debugging difficulties
suggested_approach: Implement try-catch blocks around database operations, add proper exception logging, create user-friendly error messages, implement retry logic for transient failures
success_criteria: All database operations have error handling
Users receive meaningful error messages
Errors are logged with sufficient detail for debugging
Application remains stable during error conditions

provenance.evidence: No error handling around rs.Open operation
No error handling around conn.Execute operation

title: Implement Authentication and Authorization
problem_statement: No authentication or authorization mechanisms exist for accessing sensitive banking operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to customer accounts, data breaches, regulatory violations, identity theft
suggested_approach: Implement JWT-based authentication, add role-based authorization, integrate with enterprise identity provider, add session management
success_criteria: All banking operations require authentication
Role-based access controls implemented
Session management prevents unauthorized access
Security audit confirms proper access controls

provenance.evidence: No authentication check in balance inquiry
No authorization check for deposit operation
